name: Book Employee with Spouse — Invalid Mobile Number Sequence
goal: User enters an invalid mobile number (e.g., all digits identical); bot rejects and user provides a valid number.

phases.description: User provides spouse details and appointment date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name, DOB, and appointment date.
Bot replies with 'Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9.'
Bot accepts and stores mobile number.
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
